en: Robin - Shh, quiet! Looks like we've finally reached Granada's secret vault, right?
Grinid - Heh heh, we're finally going to make our fortune. By the way, where's this new treasure they just brought in?
Robin - The guild says it came from Trisys under a big Imperial escort, so it must be something special.
Grinid - Either way, just a few of the treasures here will keep us fed for a while! Let's grab what we can! (rummage, rummage)
Grinid - Damn, we've been spotted. Robin! If you've got enough, let's get out of here!
Robin - Wait! There's a strange parchment here...
Grinid - Hurry up, there's no time! That parchment's worth nothing!
Robin - All right. But it looks important, so I'm taking it.
